description: Create a Brevo webhook (POST /webhooks). Required: url, events (array, e.g. ['delivered','opened','click','hardBounce','unsubscribed']). Optional: type (transactional|marketing|inbound), description, domain.

events.description: Event names that trigger the webhook

type.description: Webhook type: transactional, marketing or inbound

url.description: URL Brevo calls when the events occur

name: create_brevo_webhook
